085/**
086 * Custom Choco constraints. Designed for Clafer. Note that these constraints
087 * requires that the envelope and kernel to be in sorted order from lowest to
088 * highest, which is not explicitly enforced by Choco.
089 *
090 * @author jimmy
091 */
092public class Constraints {
093

099    private static Propagator<IntVar> sumEq(IntVar[] ints, IntVar sum) {
100        List<IntVar> filter = new ArrayList<>(ints.length);
101        int constant = 0;
102        for (IntVar var : ints) {
103            if (var.isInstantiated()) {
104                constant += var.getValue();
105            } else {
106                filter.add(var);
107            }
108        }
109        IntVar[] filtered
110                = filter.size() == ints.length
111                        ? ints
112                        : filter.toArray(new IntVar[filter.size()]);
113        switch (filtered.length) {
114            case 0:
115                return new PropEqualXC(sum, constant);
116            case 1:
117                if (sum.isInstantiated()) {
118                    return new PropEqualXC(filtered[0], sum.getValue() - constant);
119                }
120                return constant == 0
121                        ? new PropEqualX_Y(filtered[0], sum)
122                        : new PropEqualX_YC(new IntVar[]{filtered[0], sum}, -constant);
123            case 2:
124                if (sum.isInstantiated()) {
125                    return new PropEqualXY_C(filtered, sum.getValue() - constant);
126                } else if (constant == 0) {
127                    return new PropEqualXY_Z(filtered[0], filtered[1], sum);
128                }
129            // fallthrough
130            default:
131                return new PropSum(Util.snoc(filtered, sum), filter.size(), Operator.EQ, -constant);
132        }
133    }

135    /**
136     *******************
137     *
138     * Boolean. When using boolean constraints, beware of the cases where the
139     * documentation states that certain cardinality constraints are to be
140     * enforced elsewhere. The only reason is for efficiency.
141     *
142     *******************
143     */
144    /**
145     * A constraint enforcing
146     * {@code operands[0] ∧ operands[1] ∧ ... ∧ operands[n]}.
147     *
148     * @param operands the operands
149     * @return constraint {@code operands[0] ∧ operands[1] ∧ ... ∧ operands[n]}
150     */
151    public static Constraint and(BoolVar... operands) {
152        return new Constraint("and", new PropAnd(operands)) {
153            @Override
154            public Constraint makeOpposite() {
155                BoolVar[] nots = new BoolVar[operands.length];
156                for (int i = 0; i < nots.length; i++) {
157                    nots[i] = operands[i].not();
158                }
159                return or(nots);
160            }
161        };
162    }

172    public static Constraint lone(BoolVar... operands) {

188    /**
189     * A constraint enforcing
190     * {@code operands[0] ∨ operands[1] ∨ ... ∨ operands[n]}.
191     *
192     * @param operands the operands
193     * @return constraint {@code operands[0] ∨ operands[1] ∨ ... ∨ operands[n]}
194     */
195    public static Constraint or(BoolVar... operands) {
196        return new Constraint("or", new PropOr(operands)) {
197            @Override
198            public Constraint makeOpposite() {
199                BoolVar[] nots = new BoolVar[operands.length];
200                for (int i = 0; i < nots.length; i++) {
201                    nots[i] = operands[i].not();
202                }
203                return and(nots);
204            }
205        };
206    }

208    /**
209     * A constraint enforcing
210     * {@code constraints[0] ∨ constraints[1] ∨ ... ∨ constraints[n]}. The
211     * reason this constraint is useful is because it does not require
212     * introducing new reified variables to the solver thus can be added
213     * dynamically while the solver is in progress.
214     *
215     * @param constraints the constraints
216     * @return constraint
217     * {@code constraints[0] ∨ constraints[1] ∨ ... ∨ constraints[n]}
218     */
219    public static Constraint or(Constraint... constraints) {
220        return new OrConstraint(constraints);
221    }

223    /**
224     * A constraint enforcing
225     * {@code antecedent => consequent && !antecedent => alternative}.
226     *
227     * @param antecedent the antecedent
228     * @param consequent the consequent
229     * @param alternative the alternative
230     * @return constraint
231     * {@code antecedent => consequent && !antecedent => alternative}
232     */
233    public static Constraint ifThenElse(final BoolVar antecedent, final BoolVar consequent, final BoolVar alternative) {
234        return new Constraint("ifThenElse",
235                new PropGreaterOrEqualX_Y(new IntVar[]{consequent, antecedent}),
236                new PropGreaterOrEqualXY_C(new IntVar[]{antecedent, alternative}, 1)) {
237                    @Override
238                    public Constraint makeOpposite() {
239                        return ifThenElse(antecedent, consequent.not(), alternative.not());
240                    }
241
242                    @Override
243                    public ESat isSatisfied() {
244                        if (antecedent.isInstantiated()) {
245                            return antecedent.getValue() == 1 ? consequent.getBooleanValue() : alternative.getBooleanValue();
246                        }
247                        if (consequent.isInstantiatedTo(1) && alternative.isInstantiatedTo(1)) {
248                            return ESat.TRUE;
249                        }
250                        if (consequent.isInstantiatedTo(0) && alternative.isInstantiatedTo(0)) {
251                            return ESat.FALSE;
252                        }
253                        return ESat.UNDEFINED;
254                    }
255                };
256    }

359                new PropIntEnumMemberSet(set, element),

391    /**
392     * A constraint enforcing {@code sub ⊆ sup}. Does not enforce that
393     * {@code subCard = |sub|} nor {@code supCard = |sup|} because of how the
394     * compilation works, it is already enforced elsewhere.
395     *
396     * @param sub the subset
397     * @param subCard the cardinality of {@code sub}
398     * @param sup the superset
399     * @param supCard the cardinality of {@code sup}
400     * @return constraint {@code sub ⊆ sup}
401     */
402    public static Constraint subsetEq(SetVar sub, IntVar subCard, SetVar sup, IntVar supCard) {
403        return new Propagators(2)
404                .subsetEq(sub, sup)
405                .post(new PropSubsetEqCard(sub, subCard, sup, supCard))
406                .toConstraint("subsetEq", sub.getModel());
407    }

409    /**
410     * A constraint enforcing {@code x ∈ sets[i] <=> ints[x] = i}.
411     *
412     * @param sets the sets
413     * @param ints the integers
414     * @return constraint {@code x ∈ sets[i] <=> ints[x] = i}
415     */
416    public static Constraint intChannel(SetVar[] sets, IntVar[] ints) {
417        /*
418         * TODO: Take cardinalities of the sets into account?
419         * For example if card(sets[0]) <= 3, then if at least 3 of the integers
420         * are instantiated to 0, then remove 0 from the domains of the other integers.
421         * If card(sets[0]) >= 2 and only 2 ints contain 0 in their domain, then
422         * set those ints to 0.
423         */
424        return new Constraint("intChannel", new PropIntChannel(sets, ints));
425    }

427    /**
428     * A constraint enforcing
429     * {@code sets[i] = \{bounds[i - 1], bound[i - 1] + 1, ..., bounds[i] - 1\}}
430     * where {@code bounds[-1]} is interpreted as 0.
431     *
432     * @param sets the sets
433     * @param setCards the cardinalities of {@code sets}
434     * @param bounds the bounds
435     * @return constraint
436     * {@code sets[i] = \{bounds[i - 1], bound[i - 1] + 1, ..., bounds[i] - 1\}}.
437     */
438    public static Constraint sortedSets(SetVar[] sets, IntVar[] setCards, IntVar[] bounds) {
439        if (sets.length != setCards.length) {
440            throw new IllegalArgumentException();
441        }
442        Model model = sets[0].getModel();
443
444        Propagators propagators = new Propagators(5 * sets.length + 1);
445
446        IntVar[] boundary = new IntVar[sets.length + 1];
447        boundary[0] = model.intVar(0);
448        for (int i = 0; i < sets.length; i++) {
449            if (boundary[i].isInstantiatedTo(0)) {
450                boundary[i + 1] = setCards[i];
451            } else if (setCards[i].isInstantiatedTo(0)) {
452                boundary[i + 1] = boundary[i];
453            } else {
454                boundary[i + 1] = bounds[i];
455                propagators.add(boundary[i], setCards[i], boundary[i + 1]);
456            }
457            if (!boundary[i + 1].equals(bounds[i])) {
458                propagators.eq(boundary[i + 1], bounds[i]);
459            }
460            propagators.lowBound(sets[i], boundary[i]);
461            propagators.strictHighBound(sets[i], boundary[i + 1]);
462            propagators.memberNonempty(boundary[i], sets[i], setCards[i]);
463            propagators.continuous(sets[i], setCards[i]);
464        }
465        if (boundary[boundary.length - 1].getUB() < 0) {
466            return model.falseConstraint();
467        }
468        propagators.post(new PropContinuousUnion(sets, boundary[boundary.length - 1]));
469
470        return propagators.toConstraint("sortedSets", model);
471    }

482     */
483    public static Constraint lexChainChannel(IntVar[][] strings, IntVar[] ints) {

485            throw new IllegalArgumentException();

487        return new Constraint("lexChainChannel", new PropLexChainChannel(strings, ints));

552    /**
553     * A constraint enforcing no path from one node to another.
554     * {@code edges[i] = j} implies that there is a directed edge from node i to
555     * node j. {@code edges[i] ≥ edges.length} implies that there are no direct
556     * edges from node i.
557     *
558     * @param edges the edges of the graph
559     * @param from starting node
560     * @param to destination node
561     * @return constraint enforcing no path from one node to another
562     */
563    public static Constraint unreachable(IntVar[] edges, int from, int to) {
564        return new Constraint("unreachable", new PropUnreachable(edges, from, to));
565    }

577     * <p>
578     * A constraint enforcing {@code Σ set= sum}. Does not enforce that
579     * {@code sumCard = |sum|} because of how the compilation works, it is
580     * already enforced elsewhere.
581     * </p>
582     * <p>
583     * More * efficient than the standard operation in the Choco library when
584     * the cardinality is bounded to be relatively small.
585     * </p>
586     * <p>
587     * For example:
588     * <pre>
589     *   Animal 2
590     *     Age -> integer
591     *   [Animal.Age = 1000]
592     * </pre>
593     * </p>
594     * <p>
595     * {@code Animal.Age} is a set with a very large envelope. However, due to
596     * static analysis of the model, it is easy to see that the cardinality must
597     * be 2. In general, the cardinality is bounded by the scope of Age,
598     * although often times the analysis will find a tighter bound. Once the
599     * first integer x is selected for the set, the second integer 1000 - x is
600     * already determined due to cardinality = 2. Since the Choco library's
601     * setSum constraint is not given the cardinality, it cannot make this
602     * deduction.
603     * </p>
604     *
605     * @param set the set of integers
606     * @param setCard the cardinality of {@code set}
607     * @param sum the sum of the set
608     * @return constraint {@code Σ set= sum}
609     */
610    public static Constraint setSum(SetVar set, IntVar setCard, IntVar sum) {
611        return new Constraint("setSum", new PropSetSum(set, setCard, sum));
612    }
613
614    /**
615     *******************
616     *
617     * Set. When using set constraints, beware of the cases where the
618     * documentation states that certain cardinality constraints are to be
619     * enforced elsewhere. The only reason is for efficiency.
620     *
621     *******************
622     */
623    /**
624     * A constraint enforcing {@code {ivar} = svar} and {@code svarCard = 1}.
625     * Does not enforce that {@code svarCard = |svarCard|} because of how the
626     * compilation works, it is already enforced elsewhere.
627     *
628     * @param ivar the integer
629     * @param svar the singleton set
630     * @param svarCard the cardinality of {@code svar}
631     * @return constraint {@code {ivar} = svar}
632     */
633    public static Constraint singleton(IntVar ivar, SetVar svar, IntVar svarCard) {
634        if (svarCard.isInstantiatedTo(1)) {
635            return new Constraint("singleton",
636                    new PropSingleton(ivar, svar));
637        }
638        return new Propagators(2)
639                .post(new PropSingleton(ivar, svar))
640                .eq(svarCard, 1)
641                .toConstraint("singleton", ivar.getModel());
642    }
643
644    /**
645     * A constraint enforcing
646     * {@code if ivar = filter then {} = svar else {ivar} = svar} and
647     * {@code svarCard = 1}. Does not enforce that {@code svarCard = |svarCard|}
648     * because of how the compilation works, it is already enforced elsewhere.
649     *
650     * @param ivar the integer
651     * @param svar the singleton set
652     * @param svarCard the cardinality of {@code svar}
653     * @param filter
654     * @return constraint
655     * {@code if ivar = filter then {} = svar else {ivar} = svar}
656     */
657    public static Constraint singletonFilter(IntVar ivar, SetVar svar, IntVar svarCard, int filter) {
658        if (!ivar.contains(filter) && !svar.getUB().contains(filter)) {
659            return singleton(ivar, svar, svarCard);
660        }
661        return new Constraint("singletonFilter",
662                new PropSingletonFilter(ivar, svar, filter),
663                new PropEqualX_Y(svarCard, ivar.getModel().arithm(ivar, "!=", filter).reify())) {
664
665                    @Override
666                    public ESat isSatisfied() {
667                        if (svarCard.getLB() > 1) {
668                            return ESat.FALSE;
669                        }
670                        if (svar.getLB().size() == 1) {
671                            if (svar.getLB().min() == filter || ivar.isInstantiatedTo(filter)) {
672                                return ESat.FALSE;
673                            }
674                            if (ivar.contains(svar.getLB().min())) {
675                                return ivar.isInstantiated() ? ESat.TRUE : ESat.UNDEFINED;
676                            } else {
677                                return ESat.FALSE;
678                            }
679                        }
680                        if (!svar.getCard().contains(1)) {
681                            if (!ivar.contains(filter)) {
682                                return ESat.FALSE;
683                            }
684                            return ivar.isInstantiated() && svar.isInstantiated() ? ESat.TRUE : ESat.UNDEFINED;
685                        } else if (!svar.getCard().contains(0)) {
686                            ISetIterator iter = svar.getUB().iterator();
687                            while (iter.hasNext()) {
688                                int env = iter.nextInt();
689                                if (env != filter && ivar.contains(env)) {
690                                    return ivar.isInstantiated() && svar.isInstantiated() ? ESat.TRUE : ESat.UNDEFINED;
691                                }
692                            }
693                            return ESat.FALSE;
694                        } else if (ivar.contains(filter)) {
695                            if (ivar.isInstantiated()) {
696                                if (svar.getUB().isEmpty()) {
697                                    return ESat.TRUE;
698                                }
699                                if (!svar.getLB().isEmpty()) {
700                                    return ESat.FALSE;
701                                }
702                            }
703                            return ESat.UNDEFINED;
704                        } else if (PropUtil.isDomIntersectEnv(ivar, svar)) {
705                            return ivar.isInstantiated() && svar.isInstantiated() ? ESat.TRUE : ESat.UNDEFINED;
706                        }
707                        return ESat.FALSE;
708                    }
709                };
710    }

822    /**
823     * A constraint enforcing {@code minuend - subtrahend = difference}. Does
824     * not enforce that {@code minuendCard = |minuend|} nor
825     * {@code subtrahendCard = |subtrahend|} nor
826     * {@code differenceCard = |difference|} because of how the compilation
827     * works, it is already enforced elsewhere.
828     *
829     * @param minuend the minuend
830     * @param minuendCard the cardinality of {@code minuend}
831     * @param subtrahend the subtrahend
832     * @param subtrahendCard the cardinality of {@code subtrahend}
833     * @param difference the difference
834     * @param differenceCard the cardinality of {@code difference}
835     * @return constraint {@code minuend - subtrahend = difference}
836     */
837    public static Constraint difference(
838            SetVar minuend, IntVar minuendCard,
839            SetVar subtrahend, IntVar subtrahendCard,
840            SetVar difference, IntVar differenceCard) {
841        return new Propagators(2)
842                .post(new PropSetDifference(minuend, subtrahend, difference))
843                // Simple cardinality propagation.
844                .geq(minuendCard, differenceCard)
845                .toConstraint("difference", minuend.getModel());

848    /**
849     * A constraint enforcing
850     * {@code operands[0] ∩ operands[1] ∩ ... ∩ operands[n] = intersection}.
851     * Does not enforce that {@code operandCards[i] = |operands[i]|} nor
852     * {@code intersectionCard = |intersection|} because of how the compilation
853     * works, it is already enforced elsewhere.
854     *
855     * @param operands the operands
856     * @param operandCards the cardinalities of {@code operands}
857     * @param intersection the intersection
858     * @param intersectionCard the cardinality of {@code intersection}
859     * @return constraint
860     * {@code operands[0] ∩ operands[1] ∩ ... ∩ operands[n] = intersection}
861     */
862    public static Constraint intersection(
863            SetVar[] operands, IntVar[] operandCards,
864            SetVar intersection, IntVar intersectionCard) {
865        if (operands.length != operandCards.length) {
866            throw new IllegalArgumentException();
867        }
868
869        Propagators propagators = new Propagators(operandCards.length + 2);
870        propagators.post(new PropIntersection(operands, intersection));
871        propagators.post(operands.length == 1
872                ? new PropSetEqual(operands[0], intersection)
873                : new PropIntersectionFilterSets(operands, intersection));
874        for (int i = 0; i < operandCards.length; i++) {
875            // Simple cardinality propagation.
876            propagators.geq(operandCards[i], intersectionCard);
877        }
878        return propagators.toConstraint("intersection", intersection.getModel());
879    }

881    /**
882     * A constraint enforcing
883     * {@code operands[0] ∪ operands[1] ∪ ... ∪ operands[n] = union}. Does not
884     * enforce that {@code operandCards[i] = |operands[i]|} nor
885     * {@code unionCard = |union|} because of how the compilation works, it is
886     * already enforced elsewhere.
887     *
888     * @param operands the operands
889     * @param operandCards the cardinalities of {@code operands}
890     * @param union the union
891     * @param unionCard the cardinality of {@code union}
892     * @param disjoint the sets are disjoint
893     * @return constraint
894     * {@code operands[0] ∪ operands[1] ∪ ... ∪ operands[n] = union}
895     */
896    public static Constraint union(
897            SetVar[] operands, IntVar[] operandCards,
898            SetVar union, IntVar unionCard,
899            boolean disjoint) {
900        if (operands.length != operandCards.length) {
901            throw new IllegalArgumentException();
902        }
903
904        return new Constraint("union",
905                new PropSetUnion(operands, union),
906                disjoint
907                        ? sumEq(operandCards, unionCard)
908                        : new PropSetUnionCard(operandCards, unionCard));
909    }

1032    public static Constraint equal(
1033            IntVar[] chars1, IntVar length1,
1034            IntVar[] chars2, IntVar length2) {
1035        Propagators propagators = new Propagators(chars1.length + chars2.length + 1);
1036        propagators.eq(length1, length2);

1043        for (int i = Math.min(chars1.length, chars2.length); i < chars2.length; i++) {
1044            propagators.eq(chars2[i], 0);
1045        }
1046        return propagators.toConstraint("arrayEqual", length1.getModel());
1047    }

1089            charsAt[i] = index < strings[i].length
1090                    ? strings[i][index] : model.intVar(0);

1092        return charsAt;

1095    /**
1096     * TODO STRING
1097     */
1098    public static Constraint element(IntVar index,
1099            IntVar[][] array, IntVar[] arrayLengths,
1100            IntVar[] value, IntVar valueLength) {
1101        if (array.length != arrayLengths.length) {
1102            throw new IllegalArgumentException();
1103        }
1104        List<Propagator<IntVar>> propagators = new ArrayList<>();
1105        // See Model.element(value, table, index, offset);
1106        // TODO: Needs to add the same propagator twice because the implementation
1107        // is not guaranteed to be idempotent. If it ever becomes idempotent, then
1108        // follow their implementation.
1109        propagators.add(new PropElementV_fast(valueLength, arrayLengths, index));
1110        propagators.add(new PropElementV_fast(valueLength, arrayLengths, index));
1111        for (int i = 0; i < value.length; i++) {
1112            IntVar[] charsAt = charsAt(index.getModel(), array, i);
1113            propagators.add(new PropElementV_fast(value[i], charsAt, index));
1114            propagators.add(new PropElementV_fast(value[i], charsAt, index));
1115        }
1116        return new Constraint("Element",
1117                propagators.toArray(new Propagator<?>[propagators.size()]));
1118    }

1122     */
1123    public static Constraint prefix(
1124            IntVar[] prefix, IntVar prefixLength,
1125            IntVar[] word, IntVar wordLength) {
1126        if (prefixLength.getLB() > wordLength.getUB()) {
1127            return prefixLength.getModel().falseConstraint();
1128        }
1129        return new Propagators(2)
1130                .leq(prefixLength, wordLength)
1131                .post(new PropSamePrefix(prefixLength, prefix, word))
1132                .toConstraint("Prefix", prefixLength.getModel());
1133    }

1135    public static Constraint suffix(
1136            IntVar[] suffix, IntVar suffixLength,
1137            IntVar[] word, IntVar wordLength) {
1138        if (suffix.length == 0) {
1139            return suffixLength.getModel().trueConstraint();
1140        }
1141        Model model = suffixLength.getModel();
1142        if (suffixLength.getLB() > wordLength.getUB()) {
1143            return model.falseConstraint();
1144        }
1145        IntVar prefixLength = model.intVar("SuffixVar" + varNum++,
1146                Math.min(wordLength.getLB() - suffixLength.getUB(), 0),
1147                wordLength.getUB() - suffixLength.getLB(), false);
1148        model.post(new Constraint("SuffixVarSum",
1149                sumEq(new IntVar[]{prefixLength, suffixLength}, wordLength)));
1150
1151        Propagators propagators = new Propagators(2 * suffix.length + 1);
1152        propagators.leq(suffixLength, wordLength);
1153        for (int i = 0; i < suffix.length; i++) {
1154            IntVar[] pad = pad(word, prefixLength.getUB() + i + 1, model.intVar(0));
1155            IntVar padIndex = model.offset(prefixLength, i);
1156            // See Model.element(value, table, index, offset);
1157            // TODO: Needs to add the same propagator twice because the implementation
1158            // is not guaranteed to be idempotent. If it ever becomes idempotent, then
1159            // follow their implementation.
1160            propagators.post(new PropElementV_fast(suffix[i], pad, padIndex));
1161            propagators.post(new PropElementV_fast(suffix[i], pad, padIndex));
1162        }
1163        return propagators.toConstraint("Suffix", suffixLength.getModel());
1164    }
1165
1166    /**
1167     * TODO STRING
1168     */
1169    public static Constraint concat(
1170            IntVar[] left, IntVar leftLength,
1171            IntVar[] right, IntVar rightLength,
1172            IntVar[] concat, IntVar concatLength) {
1173        if (leftLength.getLB() + rightLength.getLB() > concatLength.getUB()) {
1174            return leftLength.getModel().falseConstraint();
1175        }
1176        List<Propagator<IntVar>> propagators = new ArrayList<>();
1177        propagators.add(sumEq(new IntVar[]{leftLength, rightLength}, concatLength));
1178        propagators.add(new PropSamePrefix(leftLength, left, concat));
1179        for (int i = 0; i < right.length; i++) {
1180            IntVar[] pad = pad(concat, left.length + i + 1, leftLength.getModel().intVar(0));
1181            IntVar padIndex = leftLength.getModel().offset(leftLength, i);
1182            // See Model.element(value, table, index, offset);
1183            // TODO: Needs to add the same propagator twice because the implementation
1184            // is not guaranteed to be idempotent. If it ever becomes idempotent, then
1185            // follow their implementation.
1186            propagators.add(new PropElementV_fast(right[i], pad, padIndex));
1187            propagators.add(new PropElementV_fast(right[i], pad, padIndex));
1188        }
1189        return new Constraint("Concat",
1190                propagators.toArray(new Propagator<?>[propagators.size()]));
1191    }
1192
1193    public static Constraint subarray(IntVar[] subarray, IntVar sublength, IntVar index, IntVar[] suparray) {
1194        if (sublength.getUB() < 0 || index.getUB() < 0 || suparray.length == 0) {
1195            return sublength.getModel().falseConstraint();
1196        }
1197        if (subarray.length == 0) {
1198            return new Constraint(null, new PropEqualXC(sublength, 0), new PropLessOrEqualXC(index, suparray.length - 1));
1199        }
1200        Propagators propagators = new Propagators(subarray.length + suparray.length + 1);
1201        for (int i = 0; i < subarray.length; i++) {
1202            IntVar[] pad = new IntVar[suparray.length];
1203            int j;
1204            for (j = 0; j < pad.length && j + i < suparray.length; j++) {
1205                pad[j] = suparray[j + i];
1206            }
1207            for (; j < pad.length; j++) {
1208                pad[j] = sublength.getModel().intVar(-1);
1209            }
1210            propagators.elementValueSupport(subarray[i], pad, index, 0, -1);
1211        }
1212        for (int i = 0; i < suparray.length; i++) {
1213            IntVar[] pad = new IntVar[suparray.length + 1];
1214            int j;
1215            for (j = 0; j < i && i - j >= 0 && i - j < subarray.length; j++) {
1216                pad[j] = subarray[i - j];
1217            }
1218            for (; j < pad.length; j++) {
1219                pad[j] = sublength.getModel().intVar(-1);
1220            }
1221            propagators.elementArraySupport(suparray[i], pad, index, 0, -1);
1222        }
1223        propagators.length(subarray, sublength, -1);
1224        return propagators.toConstraint("Substring", index.getModel());
1225    }
1226
1227    private static IntVar[] pad(IntVar[] chars, int length, IntVar zero) {
1228        if (length == chars.length) {
1229            return chars;
1230        }
1231        if (length < chars.length) {
1232            return Arrays.copyOf(chars, length);
1233        }
1234        IntVar[] pad = Arrays.copyOf(chars, length);
1235        Arrays.fill(pad, chars.length, pad.length, zero);
1236        return pad;
1237    }

1239    public static Constraint containsImpliesEqualTest(SetVar cond, int z,
1240            SetVar x, IntVar xCard, SetVar y, IntVar yCard) {
1241        return new Constraint("containsImpliesEqual",
1242                new PropContainsImpliesEqual(cond, z, x, y),
1243                new PropContainsImpliesEqualCard(cond, z, xCard, yCard),
1244                new PropContainsImpliesEqualCard2(x, xCard, y)
1245        );
1246    }

1248    public static Constraint transitive(SetVar[] relation) {
1249        return new Constraint("transitive",
1250                new PropTransitive(relation),
1251                new PropTransitiveUnreachable(relation));
1252    }
1253
1254    public static Constraint reflexive(SetVar[] relation) {
1255        return new Constraint("transitive", new PropReflexive(relation));
1256    }
1257
1258    public static Constraint transitiveClosure(SetVar[] relation, SetVar[] closure, boolean reflexive) {
1259        return reflexive
1260                ? transitiveReflexiveClosure(relation, closure)
1261                : transitiveClosure(relation, closure);
1262    }
1263
1264    public static Constraint transitiveClosure(SetVar[] relation, SetVar[] closure) {
1265        if (relation.length != closure.length) {
1266            throw new IllegalArgumentException();
1267        }
1268        Propagators propagators = new Propagators(3 * relation.length + 3);
1269        for (int i = 0; i < relation.length; i++) {
1270            propagators.subsetEq(relation[i], closure[i]);
1271            propagators.leq(relation[i].getCard(), closure[i].getCard());
1272            propagators.post(new PropTransitiveCard(closure[i], Var.mapCard(closure)));
1273        }
1274        propagators.post(new PropAtMostTransitiveClosure(relation, closure, false));
1275        propagators.post(new PropTransitive(closure));
1276        propagators.post(new PropTransitiveUnreachable(closure));
1277        return propagators.toConstraint("transitive", relation[0].getModel());
1278    }
1279
1280    public static Constraint transitiveReflexiveClosure(SetVar[] relation, SetVar[] closure) {
1281        if (relation.length != closure.length) {
1282            throw new IllegalArgumentException();
1283        }
1284        Propagators propagators = new Propagators(3 * relation.length + 4);
1285        for (int i = 0; i < relation.length; i++) {
1286            propagators.subsetEq(relation[i], closure[i]);
1287            propagators.leq(relation[i].getCard(), closure[i].getCard());
1288            propagators.post(new PropTransitiveCard(closure[i], Var.mapCard(closure)));
1289        }
1290        propagators.post(new PropAtMostTransitiveClosure(relation, closure, true));
1291        propagators.post(new PropReflexive(closure));
1292        propagators.post(new PropTransitive(closure));
1293        propagators.post(new PropTransitiveUnreachable(closure));
1294        return propagators.toConstraint("transitiveReflexive", relation[0].getModel());
1295    }
1296}
